label: refugees on the run
text: A few travellers are running for your camp with raiders on their heels. Take them in and stand with them.
notes: The refugees walk in when you accept; the raiders follow after delayHours. Done when the raid is over; fails if every refugee dies. All numbers ours.

label: a wanderer asks to join
text: A lone traveller has seen your fires and asks for a place at them.
notes: Accepting brings one colonist in at a map edge. Same person the WandererJoin incident would bring, but you can say no.

label: a supply cache
text: A dead courier's route marker says where a cache was left for whoever could use it. A drop pod brings it to your door.
notes: Accepting drops the goods near the colony's middle at once.

label: hold the line
text: Scouts say a raiding party is heading for the valley. Whoever stands against it will be paid by the people who live downriver.
notes: Accepting sends a raid of the given points after delayHours; paid when it is over, failed if it is still there at the deadline.
